name: speckit-sdd-workflow
description: Spec-Driven Development workflow — Spec Kit + MAE + Paperclip. Full 6-step SDD before any code is written.

steps.name: Step 1 — Constitution
steps.description: Generate project rules, boundaries, tech standards. Runs ONCE per project.

steps.name: Step 2 — Specify
steps.description: Convert rough idea → full spec.md. No tech stack — pure outcomes.

steps.name: Step 3 — Clarify (optional)
steps.description: Surface ambiguities before planning. Structured Q&A.

steps.name: Step 4 — Plan
steps.description: Technical architecture → plan.md, data-model.md, research.md, quickstart.md
steps.review_note: Annotate plan.md before continuing. Send back: 'Address all notes, do not implement yet'

steps.name: Step 5 — Tasks
steps.description: Break plan into small dependency-ordered tasks. [P] = parallel.

steps.name: Step 5b — Push to GitHub Issues
steps.description: Convert tasks → real GitHub Issues automatically

steps.name: Step 6 — Implement
steps.description: Execute tasks via MAE 12-agent swarm. Grounded in spec+plan+constitution.
